name: Supabase
summary: Supabase is an open-source Postgres database platform that has become a default backend for AI coding tools and vibe-coded apps.
overview: Supabase provides a hosted Postgres database with authentication, storage and APIs, used by developers and AI app builders to launch backends quickly.
bull_case: AI coding tools create huge numbers of new apps, and Supabase has become the default database many of them use.
bear_case: Much of the growth comes from free or small projects, and cloud providers offer competing managed Postgres.

intelligence.description: Supabase provides a hosted Postgres database with authentication, storage and APIs, used by developers and AI app builders to launch backends quickly.
company: Supabase was founded in 2020 by Paul Copplestone and Ant Wilson as an open-source alternative to Firebase built on Postgres. It bundles a database with authentication, file storage and APIs, and has become a common backend for apps built with AI coding tools.

In June 2026 Supabase raised a $500 million Series F led by GIC at a $10.5 billion valuation, roughly double the $5 billion it reached in its October 2025 Series E. The company reports more than 250,000 customers, 9 million developers and a 600% year-over-year increase in databases.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Supabase is one of the clearest beneficiaries of AI-assisted coding, and a read-through for how much infrastructure value flows to the tools behind vibe-coded apps.

changed.text: Supabase is founded by Paul Copplestone and Ant Wilson.
A $100M Series E values it at $5B.
A $500M Series F led by GIC values it at $10.5B.

takeaways: The valuation roughly doubled in about eight months.
Growth is tied to AI app builders that create databases automatically.
An open-source core supports adoption but can cap pricing.
Many new databases come from hobby projects, so paid conversion matters.
